After discussing with @JDogg016 in #89717 it seems like there is still another issue here. Given there are a number of fixes that have happened, but we still see issues, @JDogg016 perhaps you can explain in more detail the steps to reproduce such as:
- walk through how the event was created specifically (e.g. specific details about the due date, any time zones, etc)
- what the entity state looks like in home assistant and what is happening
- what you instead expect to happen

Thanks!

I have the following custom project as shown that is intended to show any event with the label @garage.  The snippet from configiguration.yaml is below:

```
# Example configuration.yaml entry
calendar:
  - platform: todoist
    token: XXXXXXX
    custom_projects:
      - name: 'garage'
        labels:
          - garage
```

In todoist, I create the following task:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20018778/230923926-37ddc6e8-f64a-474f-a5ff-eb8c7dd493d4.png)

The task has 'no due date' and the time zone would be default EDT.

You can see the resulting task in todoist:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20018778/230924036-16178e61-dbd3-44cd-97ed-7ed311d7e395.png)

The calendar.garage is 'off' when it should be on.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20018778/230924266-deec7bf8-dc73-4fd6-9682-e4e545971f20.png)

I think this may be because when we create an event without a due date, we set the start date/time to the current utc date/time rather than the user's timezone.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/todoist/calendar.py#L449

This diff fixes the issue using a similar example to @JDogg016 above:

```diff
diff --git a/homeassistant/components/todoist/calendar.py b/homeassistant/components/todoist/calendar.py
index c3e8f61fcc..ea5aab1534 100644
--- a/homeassistant/components/todoist/calendar.py
+++ b/homeassistant/components/todoist/calendar.py
@@ -446,7 +446,7 @@ class TodoistProjectData:
             LABELS: [],
             OVERDUE: False,
             PRIORITY: data.priority,
-            START: dt.utcnow(),
+            START: dt.now(),
             SUMMARY: data.content,
         }
 
```
Thanks Aaron, do you think this will be in the next point release?
